description: The combat benchmark in the test yard (stage E step 10): 16 box-body fighters in 8 pairs spar for 20 s (quick and power attacks, blocks and parries, staggers, knockdowns that fall as ragdolls and get up), the player standing still. With -Ablate -Kind cpu it measures the melee sweeps (melee_sweeps: the swing rays every physics step; with them off no blow lands, so the hits, staggers, knockdowns and ragdolls go too and its saving is an upper bound: the sweeps' own cost is the melee_sweeps stopwatch in the all_on run, the ragdolls' cost is the ragdolls_off saving) and the ragdolls (ragdolls: the physics engine's work on the fallen bodies, seen in the physics time; run.json's combat counts say how many ragdolls the run measured). Both change the picture (no blows land, or knockdowns tip back instead of falling), so the screenshots aren't compared; run with -Repeats 2.
